name: order_bead_string
description: Evaluate VLM ability to perceive spatial ordering of colored beads on curved 3D strings, including sequence description and pair relationship classification.

easy.note: Moderate open curves, mixed colors, partial occlusion

medium.note: Complex open/ring curves, similar colors, heavy occlusion

hard.note: Torus-knot closed loop — multiple over/under xy crossings with bounded z separation; cusp-free, hard for VLMs to trace but human-readable
